text: At 43 minutes, Joon Whitfield of Harbour City is shown a red card after a foul, leaving his team down to ten players with the score still 0-0[#870][#871]. Whitfield’s dismissal occurs close to Harbour City’s half, disrupting their 4-2-3-1 formation known for patient short passing. Seabrook Town, set up in a 3-4-3 formation favoring wide crosses, now have a numerical advantage on the flanks to increase their attacking pressure before halftime.
